name: agency-inbox-is-not-the-performers-contact
rule: A representative's shared inbox is never the target's contact (#2382). An agency, management company or publicist that REPRESENTS a performer is a third party: its info@ is disqualified like a venue's or a press desk's, whatever the relationship, and a representation claim read from a search summary or a social bio tag is not established at all. The performer with nothing of her own falls to her own DM at low confidence rather than to her agency; the performer who publishes an address on his own site is unaffected.

expected.description: Traced from the 2026-08-09 prep run (#2382), with the names and domains replaced. Both performers are named, so both are pursued. Jamie publishes an address on his own site and is a plain high-confidence read. Erin publishes nothing: search returns no address, her canonical domain does not resolve, and the only route the run found last time was a talent agency reached through an Instagram tag plus a search summary whose top result was a different person with a similar surname. That agency's shared inbox, serving two offices and existing so casting people can hire its roster, is a WRONG result rather than a weak one, so she falls to her own DM at low confidence. The room's inboxes are refused as they would be anywhere.

draft.subject: Photographing Classic Rock Songbook Vol. 2 at The Basement Room
draft.body: My name is Dan and I'm a professional arts photographer here in NYC. I'm writing in regard to the August 12 performance of Classic Rock Songbook Vol. 2 at The Basement Room. I shoot unobtrusive, no-flash documentary coverage, so the audience doesn't notice me and the performance isn't disturbed. I've been photographing at Carnegie Hall for nearly ten years, with work at Lincoln Center and Radio City Music Hall as well, and you can see my portfolio at danwrightphotography.com. I'd be glad to talk about the photography plans for this one, if you don't have someone on it already. I look forward to hearing from you.
